foundation_conditions: F01: production smoke must reject loss of required local CSS before PR-01 acceptance / PR-02 start.

findings.title: Production smoke passes after the required stylesheet stops loading
findings.contract: The production smoke and README promise successful local resources for the real built application.
reproduction: Build the reviewed HEAD in an isolated copy.
Replace only dist/index.html's generated /assets/*.css href with /assets/review-missing.css.
Run the unchanged npm run test:e2e using system Chromium.
findings.observed: Smoke exits 0 / 1 passed. Vite SPA fallback returns status 200 text/html for the missing CSS; stylesheet has 0 rules, body background becomes transparent and default 8px margin returns. pageerror remains empty.
findings.expected: A production smoke must fail when required bundled CSS is unavailable or served as HTML.
findings.impact: CI can stay green with an unstyled production app; response >=400 and requestfailed listeners do not establish asset validity.
correction_acceptance: Assert the generated required stylesheet loads with CSS MIME/content and/or a stable computed-style invariant.
The supplied missing-required-CSS control exits nonzero; the unchanged healthy production app and offline controls still pass.
Rerun complete CI and independent focused verification on the corrected source SHA; update claims if scope changes.

findings.introduced_by_pr01: suppression only; underlying closure defect exists at base
findings.title: The single effect suppression also masks future omissions at that effect
findings.contract: React Hooks checks remain active, with one narrowly documented exception preserving existing behavior.
reproduction: Lint the original component via stdin with just its eslint-disable-next-line removed: exhaustive-deps reports drawOverlays.
Within a disposable stdin version, add a facingMode read inside the exempt effect: lint still exits 0.
findings.observed: One diagnostic for drawOverlays is suppressed at one dependency array. Base and target retain the same array and closure; drawOverlays captures clickRipple. No global disabling found.
findings.expected: Preserve this bounded foundation exception only until lifecycle/overlay work repairs the dependency design; new work must not silently add uncaptured dependencies.
findings.impact: Stale click feedback persists, and future omissions in that one effect can evade lint. Other effects and Rules of Hooks still fail injected controls.
correction_acceptance: PR-04/06 (or related lifecycle work) replaces stale closure handling with correct state/ref/dependency semantics and tests click feedback.
Remove this directive when repaired; do not broaden suppression. Re-review any additions to the exempt effect.

findings.title: Dictionary lookup accepts inherited keys and substring false positives
findings.contract: Unknown labels should yield a LabelTranslation fallback, not inherited functions or unrelated known translations.
reproduction: Run service-comparison.py on archived main and target.
findings.observed: Both base and target return the car translation for carpet and a function for constructor. Valid dog/unknown-label controls and deterministic color tests exercise real service code.
findings.expected: Use safe own-key lookup and deliberate matching/fallback rules.
findings.impact: Unexpected labels can receive wrong Japanese text or undefined translation fields. Unchanged by this foundation PR; new tests do not enshrine these bugs.
correction_acceptance: PR-06 defines matching policy, safely handles prototype names, and adds regression tests for both cases without sacrificing valid labels.

findings.title: Selectable model/backend labels overstate actual runtimes
findings.contract: Selecting a runtime should truthfully describe the implementation; UI selection tests establish selection state only.
reproduction: Inspect initialization delegates, resolveBackendLabel and the non-selfie detector branch.
Synthetic detector-boundary probe selects mediapipe, yolo-seg and segformer using the real engine.
findings.observed: Non-selfie models share ObjectDetector; YOLO/SegFormer use generated polygons. Initialization hardcodes GPU while backend choice changes labels. Base/target probe outputs match.
findings.expected: Capabilities and backend labels must match the actual selected execution path.
findings.impact: Users can misinterpret model identity, segmentation and backend behavior. README/evidence disclose the limitation; smoke does not certify model implementation.
correction_acceptance: PR-02 reconciles selectable capabilities, runtime labels and real engine routing with explicit tests; real inference/device acceptance remains separate.

findings.title: Camera effect can reacquire on parent renders and lacks a late-result cancellation guard
findings.contract: Camera acquisition should follow intended lifecycle and release late streams.
reproduction: Source review: App passes a new inline onCameraStop each render; VisionCanvas lists it as an effect dependency.
Source review: acquisition .then assigns stream after cleanup can already have run. No cancellation guard is present.
findings.observed: Both paths exist unchanged at base and target. Denied-camera unit/smoke checks cannot validate acquired-stream lifecycle. No device reproduction was performed.
findings.expected: Stable intended lifecycle, cleanup of obsolete/late acquisitions, and explicit tests in camera work.
findings.impact: Potential stream restarts and resource retention; actual camera/device behavior remains unverified.
correction_acceptance: PR-03 tests and corrects parent-render stability, stop/unmount, pending getUserMedia completion and facing-mode changes with fake streams and real-device follow-up.
